title: 第十四章 心理博弈
content_zh:
“啪！”
朱县令再次怒拍惊堂木，大声喝道：“你说看到黑影杀人后翻墙离去，为何捕快今日搜查墙下花圃，没有脚印，亦没有花草践踏的痕迹。”
张杨氏一愣，漂亮的杏眼‘咕噜噜’的转了一圈，“这，这....”
张献立刻道：“大人，贼人如何潜入宅里，母亲如何知道？县衙捕快查不出来，大人也不能把罪责强加给我母子二人。”
神特么母子，你别侮辱这两个词好嘛，你那是义母吐（？）....许七安听不下去了。
朱县令大怒：“巧舌如簧，来人，给我上刑。”
这年头的审问过程大抵如此，逼问、动刑，在缺乏证据的情况下，只能这样。
因此，常常出现屈打成招。
可也没办法，取证难度很大，缺乏设备和专业技术。于是刑法就成了必不可少的程序。
利弊皆有。
张献大声道：“大人这是要屈打成招？家叔任职礼部给事中，大人就不要弹劾吗。”
所谓家叔，其实是出了五服的远房。然而血缘虽远，关系却很近，因为张家常常为那位远房亲戚输送利益。
一针见血，朱县令眉头跳了跳，他知道张家有那么一点背景。
“你敢威胁本官，来人，杖责二十。”
四名衙役上前，两名用棍子交叉锢住脖子，另外两名扒掉张献裤子，衙役们开始用力，啪啪啪的声音响彻公堂。
张献嘶声惨叫。
朱县令沉着脸，二十大板并不足以让一个人招供杀人罪名，五十大板还有可能。但也有可能把人打死。
而且，就算张献招供了，案件上交刑部，张献依旧有可能翻案，别忘记，他有一个给事中的亲戚。
到时候反而可能给自己扣一个屈打成招的帽子。
趁着张献被按在地上打板子的间隙，许七安朝着朱县令身侧的跟丁招了招手。

跟丁犹豫一下，默默退后几步，然后小跑着迎过来。
“帮我带句话，让老爷暂时休堂，我有个主意。”许七安低声道。
“你能有什么主意，莫要胡说，连累了我。”跟丁一脸不信。
“索性也审不出结果，老爷现在骑虎难下，他会答应的，回头请你喝酒。”许七安道。
“行吧....”
跟丁疾步走到朱县令面前，附耳说了几句，朱县令立刻扭头看向许七安的方向。
他沉吟一下，收回目光，一拍惊堂木：“先将两人收监，休堂。”
......
朱县令捧着婢女奉上的热茶，喝了一口。
混了几年体制，对官场规矩一知半解的许七安见状，立刻捧起茶啜一小口。
“许宁宴，你有什么主意？”
许七安惊讶于朱县令的态度，竟然出奇的温和，没摆官威。
印象里，朱县令对县衙内的胥吏可不会这么客气。难不成穿越之后，脸都好看了？
“我可以试一试。”
“不用刑？”
“自然。”
朱县令更好奇了，放下茶盏望来：“说说看。”
博弈论这玩意你也听不懂，说个毛啊....许七安笑道：“容我卖个关子，大人静候佳音便是。”
安静的禁室中，杨珍珍被带到这里，水润的眸子转动，坐立不安。
原以为胥吏要为难她，谁想把她带到这里就走人了，但这并不能打消她的不安。

“吱....”
木门被推开，一个穿着捕快服的年轻男人走了进来，高大挺拔，脸部线条刚硬，五官还算俊朗。
“别紧张，随便聊聊。”年轻男人竟然还沏了茶，笑容满面：“你可以叫我许sir。”
没受过这种优质待遇的杨珍珍不说话，警惕的盯着他。
许七安也在审视这位美妇人，不愧是被富豪看上的女人，天生丽质，姿色就比家里的婶婶差一筹。
年纪也很好，三十岁的女人，在他前世，恰是最肥美多汁的时候。
“看你这穿金戴银的，张有瑞对你很是不错。”许七安
杨珍珍不置可否。
“其实我觉得吧，以你的年纪，这么多年怀不上崽，多半是张有瑞的问题。”许七安说。
杨珍珍原本以为会是一场拷问，没想到这个年轻人的态度和语气出奇的温和。
和印象中的官差形象不同。
而且，说到不能怀孕，多半都是把罪过推到女人身上，许七安这话说的很中听。她慢慢放下心防，嘤嘤道：
“都是民妇的错，是民妇肚子不争气。这么多年才怀上孩子，老爷偏这时候遇了害。”
说着，眼圈又红了。
“人死不能复生，”许七安安慰了一句，又问：“张有瑞平时有去青楼吗。”
“自是常去的。”她说：“从古至今，大老爷大官人们，哪有不去青楼的？”
我去，你慎言啊.....五十多的年纪，常去青楼，金库空虚.....我几乎可以确认你肚子里的孩子是隔壁老王的....爱泡夜店的女孩，孕气都不会差。独守空闺的少妇也是一样。
“忽然很理解你了。”许七安啧啧两声：“女人三十如狼四十如虎，五十坐地吸尘土。张有瑞年过半百，流连青楼冷落了你，红杏出墙也是情理之中。”
“但杀人就不对了。”
杨珍珍脸色微变：“民妇不知道差爷在说什么。”

许七安笑了笑，“我看过卷宗，那张献比你小了足足七岁。”
杨珍珍板着脸：“差爷这话是什么意思。”
“你这是老鹰吃小鸡啊。”
“民妇不懂。”杨珍珍这回是真的没听懂。
“那就说一些你懂的。”许七安沉声道：“张杨氏，你独守空闺，难耐寂寞。于是勾引继子，做出了无耻背德之事。”
“事发当晚，你趁着张有瑞下乡收租，便与继子偷情。谁知张有瑞提前归来，撞破你俩奸情。父子俩撕打起来，你用花瓶从后面砸死了张有瑞。”
“为了掩盖罪行，你们将张有瑞的尸体拖到院中，伪装成贼人盗窃杀人。张献故意在墙上留下脚印，以证实你的说辞。”
杨珍珍脸色煞白煞白，难以置信的盯着许七安。
“我没有，我是冤枉的。”杨珍珍大声道，双手握成拳头，掌心汗津津的。
她心慌了....在审讯领域下过苦功夫的许七安，收敛了温和，面无表情，透着一股冷漠：
“你不奇怪我为什么知道的这么清楚？因为张献已经招供了。”
这不可能……杨珍珍眼里闪过这样的情绪，脸又苍白了几分，强做镇定，依旧不认：“民妇冤枉。”
“是不是觉得你的奸夫不可能认罪？”许七安面无表情。
明明没有疾言厉色的威胁，偏偏让美妇人愈发心里发毛。
“因为你们自以为处理的天衣无缝，其实破绽百出。”
“张献只在墙上留了出去的脚印，却没有入宅留下的脚印，贼人若是有不错的身法，那逃离时更会激发潜能，根本不会留下脚印。这是其一。”
“其二，张有瑞死于钝器打击，而非利器。按照大奉律法，凡夜无故入家者，杖八十。主家登时格杀者，勿论。”许七安敲了敲桌子：
“试问，哪个入宅偷窃的贼人会不带武器？可偏偏张有瑞是死于钝器。”
杨珍珍容貌呆滞。
“我还没说完呢....”许七安冷笑一声。击垮了杨珍珍的心理防线后，接下来才是杀招。
content_en:
"Crack!"
Magistrate Zhu slapped the gavel tree angrily again and shouted loudly: "You said you saw the shadowy figure jumping over the wall after killing someone and leaving. Why did the police search the flower garden under the wall today? There were no footprints or traces of trampling on flowers and plants."
Zhang Yang was stunned, and her beautiful almond-shaped eyes turned in a circle, "This, this..."
Zhang Xian immediately said: "Sir, how did the thief sneak into the house and how did the mother know? The county police officer can't find it out quickly, and you can't impose the blame on my mother and son."
God damn mother and son, please don't insult these two words, what are you saying (?)? Xu Qi'an couldn't listen anymore.
Magistrate Zhu was furious: "Speaking like a silver tongue, come here and put me to death."
The interrogation process these days is generally like this. Forced questioning and torture can only be done in the absence of evidence.
Therefore, it is often the case that subjugation turns into a move.
But there is nothing that can be done. Obtaining evidence is very difficult and there is a lack of equipment and professional skills. So criminal law has become an indispensable procedure.
There are pros and cons.
Zhang Xian said loudly: "Your Excellency, are you going to give in? My uncle is appointed to the Ministry of Etiquette, so why don't you impeach me?"
The so-called family uncle is actually a distant relative who left the fifth server. However, although the blood relationship is far away, the relationship is very close, because the Zhang family often provides benefits to the distant relative.
Hitting the nail on the head, Magistrate Zhu’s brows twitched. He knew that the Zhang family had some background.
"If you dare to threaten me, I will give you twenty sticks."
Four government officials stepped forward, two of them strangled Zhang Xian's neck with sticks, and the other two took off Zhang Xian's pants. The officials began to exert force, and the sound of snapping resounded throughout the courtroom.
Zhang Xian screamed.
Magistrate Zhu had a stern look on his face. Twenty boards was not enough for a person to confess to murder. Fifty boards was still possible. But it's also possible to beat someone to death.
Moreover, even if Zhang Xian confesses and the case is handed over to the Ministry of Justice, Zhang Xian may still reverse the case. Don't forget that he has a relative involved in the matter.
When the time comes, you may label yourself as someone who surrendered to a trick.
While Zhang Xian was being pushed to the ground and playing with the board, Xu Qian waved to Ding who was standing next to Magistrate Zhu.
He Ding hesitated for a moment, silently took a few steps back, and then trotted over to meet him.
"Give me a message to ask the master to temporarily suspend the court. I have an idea." Xu Qian whispered.
"What ideas do you have? Don't talk nonsense and get me into trouble." He Ding looked unbelieving.
"There is no result from the trial at all. The master is riding a tiger now. He will agree and treat you to a drink later." Xu Qian said.
"Okay..."
He and Ding walked quickly to Magistrate Zhu and whispered a few words. Magistrate Zhu immediately turned his head and looked in Xu Qian's direction.
He pondered for a moment, withdrew his gaze, and said with a startled expression: "Put the two of them in prison first, and suspend the proceedings."
...
Magistrate Zhu took a sip of the hot tea served by his maid.
Xu Qian, who had been involved in the system for several years and knew only a little about the rules of the officialdom, saw this and immediately took a sip of tea.
"Xu Ningyan, what do you have in mind?"
Xu Qian was surprised that Magistrate Zhu's attitude was surprisingly gentle and did not show official authority.
In my impression, Magistrate Zhu would not be so polite to the subordinate officials in the county government. Is it possible that my face looks better after traveling through time?
"I can give it a try."
"No punishment?"
"Natural."
Magistrate Zhu became even more curious. He put down his tea cup and looked at it: "Tell me about it."
You don’t understand this thing like game theory, it’s just silly...Xu Qian said with a smile: “Allow me to give you a pass, sir, just wait for the good news.”
In the quiet forbidden room, Yang Zhenzhen was brought here, her watery eyes turned, and she was restless.
She originally thought that the subordinate officials were going to make things difficult for her, and whoever wanted to bring her here would leave, but this did not dispel her uneasiness.
"Squeak...."
The wooden door was pushed open, and a young man wearing a police officer's uniform walked in. He was tall and straight, with strong facial lines and fairly handsome features.
"Don't be nervous, just chat." The young manThe man actually made tea and said with a smile on his face: "You can call me Sir Xu."
Yang Zhenzhen, who had never received such good treatment, said nothing and stared at him warily.
Xu Qi'an was also looking at this beautiful woman. She was indeed a woman favored by the rich. She was naturally beautiful, but her appearance was inferior to that of her aunt at home.
His age is also very good. A thirty-year-old woman was at her most plump and juicy in his previous life.
"Looking at you wearing gold and silver, Zhang Yourui treats you very well." Xu Qian
Yang Zhenzhen was noncommittal.
"Actually, I think, given your age, the fact that you haven't been able to conceive a baby for so many years is probably Zhang Yourui's fault." Xu Qian said.
Yang Zhenzhen originally thought it would be a torture, but she didn't expect this young man's attitude and tone to be surprisingly gentle.
It is different from the image of official officials in my impression.
Moreover, when it comes to being unable to get pregnant, most people blame the woman. Xu Qi'an's words are very pleasant. She slowly let go of her guard and whispered:
"It's all the common woman's fault. It's the common woman's poor belly. It took so many years to get pregnant, but the master was killed at this time."
As he spoke, his eye circles turned red again.
"Dead people cannot be resurrected," Xu Qian comforted him, and then asked, "Does Zhang Yourui usually go to a brothel?"
"Of course I go there often." She said: "From ancient times to the present, how can the great masters and high officials not go to brothels?"
I'm going, please be careful... You are over fifty, you often go to brothels, your coffers are empty... I can almost confirm that the child in your belly belongs to Lao Wang next door... A girl who loves to go to nightclubs will not be bad at pregnancy. The same goes for the young woman who stays alone in her empty boudoir.
"Suddenly I understand you very well." Xu Qian tutted twice: "A woman is like a wolf at thirty and a tiger at forty. She sits on the ground and sucks dust at fifty. Zhang Yourui is over 50 years old and has been neglecting you by hanging around a brothel. It is reasonable for Hongxing to cheat on you."
"But it's not right to kill people."
Yang Zhenzhen's face changed slightly: "A civilian woman doesn't know what Mr. Cha is talking about."
Xu Qian smiled and said, "I have read the file and that Zhang Xian is seven years younger than you."
Yang Zhenzhen said with a straight face: "What do you mean by Master Cha?"
"You are an eagle eating a chicken."
"A civilian woman doesn't understand." Yang Zhenzhen really didn't understand this time.
"Then tell me something you know." Xu Qian said in a deep voice: "Ms. Zhang Yang, you were alone in your empty boudoir and couldn't bear the loneliness. So you seduced your stepson and committed a shameless act."
"On the night of the incident, you took advantage of Zhang Yourui to go to the countryside to collect rent and had an affair with your stepson. Unexpectedly, Zhang Yourui came back early and broke up your adultery. The father and son fought, and you smashed Zhang Yourui to death from behind with a vase."
"In order to cover up the crime, you dragged Zhang Yourui's body into the courtyard and pretended to be a thief to steal and kill. Zhang Xian deliberately left footprints on the wall to confirm your story."
Yang Zhenzhen's face turned pale and she stared at Xu Qian in disbelief.
"I didn't, I was wronged." Yang Zhenzhen said loudly, her hands clenched into fists, and her palms were wet with sweat.
She was flustered... Xu Qian, who had worked hard in the field of interrogation, restrained his gentleness, his face was expressionless, and showed a sense of indifference:
"Aren't you surprised why I know so clearly? Because Zhang Xian has already confessed."
This is impossible... Such emotions flashed through Yang Zhenzhen's eyes, and her face turned a little pale. She forced herself to remain calm and still refused to admit it: "The civilian woman has been wronged."
"Do you think it's impossible for your adulterer to plead guilty?" Xu Qian's face was expressionless.
There was obviously no harsh threat, but it made the beautiful woman even more frightened.
"Because you think you handled it flawlessly, but it's actually full of flaws."
"Zhang Xian only left footprints on the wall for leaving the house, but no footprints for entering the house. If the thief had good movement skills, he would have unleashed his potential when escaping and would not have left any footprints at all. This is one of them."
"Secondly, Zhang Yourui died from blunt force blows rather than sharp weapons. According to the law of Dafa, anyone who enters the house without any reason at night, the stick is eighty. Those who are killed immediately by the master's family should be ignored. "Xu Qian knocked on the table:
“Let me ask, which thief would break into a house without weapons? But Zhang Yourui died from blunt force. "
Yang Zhenzhen looked dull.
"I haven't finished speaking yet..." Xu Qian sneered. After defeating Yang Zhenzhen's psychological defense, the next step is the killer move.
